name: Oil in the Blood
source:
You are a lonely human coping with the recent death of your best friend, which you believe happened at the hands of a robot. So when none other than a robot comes to your doorstep carrying a knife and asking to be let in, you're more than a little cautious. But is this robot as they seem? Are they really out to get you?

Or are they just lonely as well?

[From [url=https://killjoyconstruct.itch.io/oil-in-the-blood]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一个孤独的人，正在应对你最好的朋友最近的死亡，你相信这件事是死于机器人之手。因此，当一个机器人拿着刀来到你家门口并要求进入时，你会变得非常谨慎。但这个机器人真像他们看起来的那样吗？他们真的是来抓你的吗？

或者他们也只是孤独？

[来自[url=https://killjoyconstruct.itch.io/oil-in-the-blood]itch.io[/url]]
